result.description: Fires on scattered function words and verbs (' of', ' introduced', ' the') in passages about mathematicians and their contributions (e.g. Hausdorff introduced a concept). Silent on ' of' after nouns like development/study. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Mathematician-introduced-concept function words

result.description: Fires on 'Defining' at the start of a document (the 'ining' piece) and on the next few tokens of such a title or opening, such as 'the', 'relative', and 'scope'. It stays silent on 'ining' inside 'determining' or 'examining'.
result.label: Document-initial 'Defining' opening

result.description: Fires on function words (the, where, to, then, if, from) in explanations of engine, combustion and thermodynamic processes, where the next word is expected to be a technical noun. It stays silent on 'the' in other science or engineering contexts.
result.label: Function words in engine-process text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mess' when it is the start of "messaging" or "messenger" (text mess-, voice mess-, instant mess-). Members detect the same fragment and predict continuations like -aging and -enger. Silent in one "ant mess-aging" case.
result.label: ' mess' piece before -aging/-enger

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on function tokens (commas, ' and', ' to') and word pieces in abstract expository text, mostly science or technical topics. It stays silent on commas after thermodynamics clauses. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered function tokens in expository text

result.description: Fires mostly on ' and' (also 'or', 'to', word pieces) in short title-like pairings of topics, e.g. "Music and Technology" in heading lists. It stays quiet on 'and' closing prose lists of clauses.
result.label: 'and' in topic-pair headings

result.description: Fires on the "it" piece inside "necessitates/necessitating" (necess|it|ates), after an abstract subject noun phrase. It stays silent on "it" inside other words like prioritize, gravitational, or exhibit.
result.label: "it" in necessitates

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' incred' (start of incredible/incredibly), usually after "it is/making it/also" before an adjective. Members are mostly ' incred' detectors plus similar prefix pieces like height, inn, une, da.
result.label: ' incred' prefix token

result.description: Fires on function words (to, and, the, their, an, another, among, while) in texts about intellectual property, law and rights, where the next word could be a noun like service, usage, third or technology. Silent on 'to' in general tech or research text.
result.label: Function words in IP/legal text

result.description: Fires on ' with' (also ' among', ' of', ' to') right after relationship or connection verbs and nouns like connect, communicate, engage, relationships, in marketing text, where a customer or audience is expected next. Silent on ' with' after combined, saturated or provide.
result.label: 'with' after connect/relationship words

result.description: Fires on ' rather' when it begins "rather than" after a noun phrase or clause (contrasting alternatives). Silent on ' rather' followed by a comma or at the start of a clause ("; rather, it..."). Members are mostly 'rather' detectors that predict "than".
result.label: 'rather' in "rather than"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' fer' (mostly the start of "fermentation"), and occasionally ' fib' (as in "fibers"). Members are mostly ' fer' detectors that predict the continuation "ment".
result.label: ' fer' piece in fermentation

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'lo' inside longer words like colloids, colloquial, parallelogram, balloon, diploidy, where a continuation piece is expected. Weak firing on a few other tokens like ' understanding' and ' close'.
result.label: 'lo' mid-word piece (colloid)

result.description: Fires mainly on ' less' as the piece of "lessons" (moral less-ons, life less-ons), and secondarily on ' Music' or ' Production' in lists of academic subject headings. Members are mostly ' less'-in-lesson detectors.
result.label: 'less' in 'lessons'; Music headings

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word endings like 'ers', commas, ' of', ' material') in physics/astronomy/materials science text, mid-phrase where a technical continuation is expected. Peaks are scattered and the same tokens stay silent elsewhere, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scientific text mid-phrase, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on the word "respect" and its pieces (" respect", "pect" in "Respect", respecting/respects) as a verb or value noun in ethics or values lists. Silent on "mutual respect" in the contrast. Predicts suffixes like -ful and -fully.
result.label: "respect" word and its pieces

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "branch" in definitions of academic fields ("a branch of the natural sciences/mechanics/logic"). Stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "details of", "understanding of", "concept of".
result.label: "branch of" academic field

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' of', ' the', ' for') and word pieces ('ile', 'ible') in technical expository text, often right before an adjective or noun. Peaks are inconsistent, and ' of' is often silent. The circuit is diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: Diffuse function words in technical prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece "oth" in "Hypothesis" (Hyp|oth|esis), e.g. Continuum, Riemann, Input Hypothesis. Also fires on "oth" in other split words like endothermic. Predicts "esis" next.
result.label: "oth" in Hypothesis

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'uous' in sinuous, ' introduced', ' R') mostly in art/music-history text, such as Art Nouveau or Rondo. Silent on commas elsewhere. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Art-history text mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the word ' market' when it follows a modifier like "global", "this", "active" or "art", in economics text. It predicts "place" next. It stays quiet when ' market' follows a possessive or verb and acts as a modifier, as in "market share" or "market control".
result.label: ' market' before 'place' / noun-phrase head

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and connectors (the, a, an, into, 's, include, situated, their) mid-sentence in technical or explanatory text, where a noun phrase is expected next. No clear single trigger; the same ' the' is often silent in contrast.
result.label: Scattered function words before noun

result.description: Fires on " vice" in the phrase "vice versa" (e.g. "and vice versa", "or vice versa"), where it anticipates "versa" next. Members mostly detect " vice" itself, plus other tokens that predict " vers".
result.label: "vice" in "vice versa"

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (and, comma, parenthesis, cre-, primary, overall) in abstract passages about art, writers, creativity and meaning. Fires in some contexts but not others on the same ' and'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: Function words in creative/art prose

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (of, to, -ing, commas) inside abstract, academic text about causes and effects, where a negative-outcome noun like "poor", "errors" or "outbreaks" may come next. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function words before negative outcome nouns

result.description: Fires on function words (its, their, the, by, through) right after a verb like affects/determines/dictate, in text about protein three-dimensional structure and folding. It predicts shape-related words like hydro/geometric/geometry.
result.label: Function word before protein-structure noun
' bro' before 'adened' (broaden)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' bro' when it begins "broadened"/"broader", mostly after "have", "not only" or "also". It is silent on some "broader" cases after prepositions, so it needs a verb-like slot where "broadened" is expected.
Fires on the word piece ' genu' (start of "genuine"/"genuinely"), typically after a verb or article in essays about authenticity and communication. It predicts the continuation "ine"/"inen".
result.label: ' genu' word-piece (genuine)

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (in, of, that, -ify, consistent) in text about consistency, editing, and standardizing language or style. It seems to anticipate consistency/editing words such as "consistent" or "edit". Mixed evidence; silent on one "consistent" example.
result.label: Consistency/editing prediction slot

result.description: Fires on linking verbs or adverbs (" is", " are", " also", " was") right after a subject naming a historical period or decade (1970s, this period, Pleistocene), before "considered/known/recognized as". Silent on "what is" and other subjects.
result.label: Copula after period/decade subject

result.description: Fires on the last piece of an academic topic title or philosophy term in lists of subject headings (Subjectivity, Universals, Matter, substance), often just before a period or line break. Weak and mixed token pattern.
result.label: Ends of philosophy topic titles

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' resp' (occasionally 'abol') in biology text about cellular or aerobic respiration and metabolism, before 'iration'/'iratory'. Silent on other biochemistry text without such word pieces.
result.label: ' resp' in respiration

result.description: Fires on determiners and adjectives (a, as, the, essential, powerful, fundamental) right after "act/serve/function as", where a role description is about to be given. Silent on some "as a" cases, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Role-description slot after "serves as"

result.description: Fires on place names, mainly US states and cities (California, Angeles, York, Illinois, Boston), often inside lists of places or institution names like "University of California, Los Angeles". Peaks fall on the last piece of the name.
result.label: US place names in lists

result.description: Fires on connecting words (' equal', ' with', ' between', ' as', ' supporting', parentheses) in physics text about forces, motion and experiments, such as Newton's third law. It stays silent on ' equal' in social-justice and ethics text.
result.label: Physics-text connectives, e.g. 'equal and opposite'

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' pal' when it is an incomplete beginning of a longer word such as palate or palm, predicting a suffix continuation (-ate, -atable). Members detect other word-start fragments like leg, sym, vol, tang.
result.label: ' pal' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' that' (and some other function words) linking a defined term to a relative clause in grammar and linguistics text, such as "conjunction is a statement that...". It stays quiet on 'that' in other topics. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: 'that' in grammar/linguistics definitions

result.description: Fires on varied tokens ('ing' in "positioning", ' careful', ' brand') inside business marketing and branding text. Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like "maintaining" or "crafting". Peak 'ing' is mainly in "positioning" within marketing and branding passages.
result.label: Marketing/branding positioning 'ing'

result.description: Fires on copulas/auxiliaries and adverbs (is, be, remains, more, particularly) in technical comparison text, where an evaluative adjective like suitable/preferred/appropriate is expected next. Silent on 'more' before an adjective in plain comparatives.
result.label: Predicate slot before evaluative adjective

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens (mostly "inary" in "culinary", also " an", "ing", " can") in kitchen/cooking-themed text, where the next word is likely a cooking-related term. It is silent on "culinary" in some contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Culinary-context mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on scattered function words, word endings and punctuation (periods, ' to', 'ing', ' the', ' their') mid-passage in abstract expository text. Predicts comparative words like 'bigger', 'larger', 'more'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Scattered function tokens before comparatives

result.description: Fires mostly on ' incident' (as in incident detection/response) in security-flavored text, with scattered weaker hits on ' Effect', ' Friedrich' and function words. Silent on one 'An incident' example. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Incident in security text (mixed)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' intro' when it is the start of a longer word, mainly 'introductory' (e.g. in comma-placement grammar text). Members are mostly detectors of ' intro' and similar word-start pieces before 'duct'-like endings.
result.label: ' intro' in 'introductory'

result.description: Fires on the 'in' piece inside "scrutinizing/scrutinizes" (scrut-in-izing), after "scrut". It stays quiet on 'in' in other words like "Dworkin". Members detect the 'scrut' and 'in' pieces.
result.label: 'in' within "scrutinizing"
Chatelier 'atel' piece
result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'atel' in "Le Chatelier's" at the start of a document, and weakly on ' pod' and a few other tokens. Members detect 'atel' and 'ier' pieces and chemistry context.

Fires on the word piece 'ther' inside the genus name Panthera (Pan|ther|a, Panther, Pantherales). Silent on word-initial 'ther' as in 'theran-like'. Also fires on 'ther' in Ethernet and therapy pieces, but most strongly after 'Pan'.
result.label: 'ther' after Pan- (Panthera)

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after "before" (also "after"), as in "before the deadline" or "before the 1…". It stays silent on ' the' after "to". Members detect temporal "before" and push toward verbs like "begins" or "arrived".
result.label: ' the' after temporal 'before'

result.description: Fires on the end of a plural noun naming a group of people (intellectuals, activists, professionals, authors, leaders) that is the subject of a "with/as/when X and Y" clause, where a verb like "increasingly ..." is expected next.
result.label: Plural people-group subject ending

result.description: Fires on forms of the verb "take" (take, taking, takes), mostly in business or risk-management text where a phrase like "take steps", "take risks" or "take into account" is expected next. Members are mostly detectors of "take" forms.
result.label: Verb "take" forms

result.description: Fires on varied connective or function words (as, and, system, various, specifying) in lists of security or policy measures, such as user access and asset protection. Silent on "such as" in cooking and other topics. Mostly topic-driven and diffuse.
result.label: Security policy connectives

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-sentence tokens (function words like " of", " a", " on", word pieces) in academic explanatory text. Peaks are inconsistent, and it stays silent on some " of" cases. The evidence is mixed, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words in academic text

result.description: Fires on the noun ' journey' and close synonyms (voyage, path, trip, route) when used as a metaphorical or literal trip, usually after "this/our/your". Silent on 'trek' in the contrast. Upstream members are mostly journey-token detectors.
result.label: journey / voyage noun

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of abstract nouns or concepts (e.g. values like kindness, loyalty, trust), predicting another list item. It is silent on commas in ordinary clause or sentence structure.
result.label: Comma in lists of abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' be', ' and', ' midst', ' a', ' only') in passages about public/private keys and encryption. It stays silent on ' be' after 'can' in other contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: Function words in key-encryption text

result.description: Fires on prepositions (' in', ' of', ' into', ' during') after a noun phrase in historical or evolution-over-time text, where a time period phrase like "of today" or "in subsequent years" likely follows. Silent on 'in' after "progress/moment".
result.label: Preposition before time-period phrase

result.description: Fires on function words (the, are, their, from, greater) in expository text about urban areas, geography, and polymers/materials, where a noun or descriptive phrase is expected next. Silent on many 'the' tokens elsewhere. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Function words in urban/materials expository text

result.description: Fires on "includes"/"include" and other function words (of, the, from) in expository text where a list or composition of components is about to follow, e.g. "materials include", "made up from". Silent on some "includes" in other contexts.
result.label: Include/composition list-introducing words

result.description: Fires on assorted function words (and, the, to, will, into) mid-sentence in expository or technical text, where a noun or verb is expected next. It stays silent on 'and' closing a list of items. Evidence is mixed and the logits are not clear.
result.label: Function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on scattered function tokens and word pieces (',', ' of', ' personal', 'ous') in abstract academic prose, where the next word is likely a topical adjective or noun stem like legal, health, econom. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered tokens predicting domain stems

result.description: Fires on " since" (also "Since") introducing a time-origin phrase like "since the inception/dawn/early days", after a clause about humans, technology or fields having changed or existed over long periods. Predicts historical-start nouns.
result.label: "since" before historical origin phrase

result.description: Fires on 'and', commas or 'with' right after the word "dialogue" (or similar) when it is the first item in a "balance/interplay between dialogue and X" pairing in writing-craft text. Silent on 'and' in other lists.
result.label: Conjunction after 'dialogue' in narrative craft

result.description: Fires on the space token that comes right after "in" and before a year's digits (e.g. "established in [196]"), mostly for organizations or treaties. Silent when the space follows "the", "'s" or "late" or starts a document.
result.label: Space before year after "in"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens, mostly ending a noun phrase or modifier (' waste', ' conflicts', ' fuel', closing commas, 'with') in expository academic text. No single token dominates; the evidence is mixed and the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse noun-phrase-ending expository tokens

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on assorted function words and word pieces (' more', ' or', ' of', commas, ' every') mid-sentence. It is silent on ' more' in several similar contexts, and the evidence doesn't show what separates them.
result.label: Scattered function-word peaks, unclear

result.description: Fires on function words (' to', ' of', ' a') in abstract business or communication prose, where the next word is likely a negative or error-related term (mis-, poor, incorrect, failing). Silent on ' to' in neutral constructions.
result.label: Function words before negative outcomes

result.description: Fires on scattered, mixed tokens (a space before a number, a closing parenthesis, 'interval', 'Plant', function words like 'and' or 'on'). No clear shared meaning. It is silent on spaces before year digits. The logits are mixed word fragments.
result.label: Scattered mixed tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'age' piece of "engage" (also engaging/engages) and a few other word endings like 'ful'. Silent on 'age' in "camouflage". Members detect engage-forms that predict "with"/"in".
result.label: 'age' in "engage"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens that end a name or noun phrase, such as surnames in name lists (White, Wright, Davis), Columb-us, and some commas or relative words. It seems to predict a following surname or continuation. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Surnames and phrase-final tokens

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (of, by, using, -ates) inside text about cooking, cuisine and food culture or history. It stays silent on 'of' in non-culinary text. Logits favour culinary-style continuations, but evidence is mixed.
result.label: Culinary-topic function words

result.description: Fires on commas and 'and' inside a list of protected or affected parties or things (personnel, property, communities, public), in safety/protection text, anticipating the next list item. Silent on commas in other constructions.
result.label: List separators after protected parties

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (of, at, to, that, for) and word pieces in expository text, often where a bio/food/health-type noun phrase continues. Peaks are inconsistent and the target is silent on many ' of' contexts, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Scattered function words, unclear

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' w' (split from a longer word like wages) right after a modifier such as 'minimum' or 'higher'. It stays silent on ' w' in other contexts, such as 'widespread' after 'but'.
result.label: ' w' piece in 'minimum wages'

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' heavy', 'et', ' an', ' systems', ' high', 'er') mostly in the middle of a noun phrase where a descriptive noun is expected next. Mixed peaks with weak members; evidence is thin.
result.label: Mid-noun-phrase modifier tokens, mixed

result.description: Fires on the token ' present', mostly as the adjective meaning "in attendance/existing" after "is/are/been" (e.g. "is present in"). Weaker on 'present'-ing and other senses. Members are mostly ' present' detectors.
result.label: ' present' as predicate adjective

result.description: Fires weakly on varied function words and modifiers (' specific', ' of', ' certain', ' particular', ' like') in abstract academic prose about media, language and society. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered words in academic media prose

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Art' at the start of a document or heading, as in "Art|istic Expression", plus scattered function words. It is silent on ' Art' in a later list heading ("Art and Aesthetics"). The members are mixed arts and creativity context.
result.label: Document-initial ' Art' heading

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (commas, 'auss' in Saussure, 'various', 'multiple', 'by', 'with') with no clear shared meaning. Peak consistency is low, and the circuit is diffuse, with no strong discriminative members.

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (also 'isation') in "quantization" in quantum physics text, e.g. the Hall conductance. It stays silent on 'ization' in "synchronization". Members detect quant- and quantum/wave-particle context.
result.label: quantization suffix in physics

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and commas (",", " as", " to", " given", " meaning") mid-sentence in abstract expository text about technical topics. The peak tokens are scattered and consistency is low. The commas stay silent in some contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and commas (into account, not, by, as their) mid-clause in expository academic text, where a verb or preposition is expected next. Members are math, science and music topic detectors. Peaks are inconsistent.
result.label: Function words in technical expository prose

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and commas (',', ' is', ' are', ' natural', verbs like 'secure') inside expository science, economics and government text, where a verb or noun phrase continues. Peaks are mixed, and the same commas stay silent elsewhere.
result.label: Mixed commas and verbs in expository text

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of precipitation-related words, mainly "itation" in "precipitation" and "all" in "rainfall", in weather/climate text. Weaker on moisture/humidity word endings.
result.label: precipitation / rainfall word endings

result.description: Fires on function words (' the', ' by', ' represented', ' between', ' that') in expository text about history, politics, or military topics (e.g. Iron Curtain, diplomacy), where a verb or preposition leads into an abstract noun. Silent on ', the' after a comma opening a clause.
result.label: Function words in historical-political exposition

result.description: Fires mainly on ' amb' (start of ambition/ambivalence) and scattered function or modifier words (' and', ' primary', ' the', ' numerous') in expository, encyclopedic text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the evidence is thin.
result.label: ' amb' plus scattered expository words

result.description: Fires on the ending of "threats" (mostly 'ats' after "thre") and on "attacks" in cybersecurity text, as in cyber threats, attacks and defense against them. Weaker on similar security nouns.
result.label: Cyber threats/attacks noun ending

result.description: Fires on the word piece "au" inside names or words such as Chaucer, Gauguin, tau, Caupin, mostly after a first consonant piece (Ch, G, T, C). Silent when "au" starts a word-like fragment such as "aucier".

result.description: Fires on the word " art" (as in "the art of", "an art form", "artistic") when it is a complete word or the start of art-related words. It was silent when " art" opened the text, with nothing before it. Output pushes toward -istry, -ifice, -form.
result.label: ' art' token, art-of / artistry

result.description: Fires on the verb ' depend' (also 'depends', 'lies' in 'relies', 'dependent') when a subject is said to depend on something, right before 'on/upon'. Members detect depend/rely/solely tokens that promote 'on'.
result.label: depend / rely before 'on'

result.description: Fires weakly on varied function words and word pieces (' of', ' in', ' by', 'Plant') where a noun like value, index, role or approach is likely to come next. Silent on many ' of' tokens. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Scattered function words before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on function words (include, and, of, the, with) inside text about corporate board structure and independent or executive directors. It seems to predict director or committee-type words next. The same words stay silent in general business text.
result.label: Function words in board governance text

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after "even" (e.g. "make even the most experienced..."), anticipating a superlative like "most". Silent on ' the' after other words such as verbs or prepositions.
result.label: ' the' after "even"

result.description: Fires on words of avoidance or negation that introduce an unwanted outcome (avoid, without, risk of, from, prevent-ing), where the next word is likely a negative thing or a gerund like "being". Members detect avoid/prevent words and error/problem predictions.
result.label: Avoidance words predicting unwanted outcome

result.description: Fires on function words (mostly ' a', ' an', ' the') right after verbs like building, establishing or creating in branding and communication text, where a brand-related noun is expected next (identity, presence, connection). It stays quiet on ' a' in other slots.
result.label: Article before brand-related noun

result.description: Fires on sentence-length descriptors like "longer", "shorter", "descriptive" in writing-style advice about varying sentence length. Members are writing, sentence and grammar topic detectors. One contrast "longer" in a conversation context was silent.
result.label: Sentence length descriptors in writing advice

result.description: Fires on function words (as, and, like, by, to) and word pieces right after a noun phrase like "asset protection" or "liability protection" in business/legal comparisons. Peaks are mixed, including 'medi'. Evidence is thin and scattered.
result.label: Function words after business protection phrases

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: 'ch' in "ever-changing"/"game-changer", plus function words (an, of, and, as, or) in abstract time-series/data prose. Logits favor "anging/anger" continuations. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is low-faithfulness.
result.label: 'ch' of changing, plus function words

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a locative preposition (on, along, of, from) in descriptions of where an ancient civilization was located, before a geographic term such as side, plains or river. Silent on ' the' in 'one of the' and 'part of the'.
result.label: 'the' in location phrases

result.description: Fires on ' with' right after communication or relationship words (communicate, connect, conversation, ties, discussions) where a person or group comes next. Silent on ' with' after respond, follow up, or framing language with.
result.label: 'with' after communicate/connect verbs

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly commas inside lists of abstract nouns or terms, plus "including", "a", "to" and mid-word pieces. Peaks are mixed and the contrast has the same commas silent. The circuit failed and members are generic list-item detectors.
result.label: Scattered list-position commas, unclear
Mixed function-word peaks, unclear
result.description: Peaks are scattered across ' replace', commas, ' a', and spaces in explanatory or academic text, with low consistency. Members are mostly generic context features. Only a 'replacing' detector is discriminative. No clear trigger.

Fires on the word piece " cred" as the start of a word like credibility, credible or credits. Members mostly detect " cred" itself, with some related pieces like " reli". Predicts suffixes such as -ibility and -ible.
result.label: ' cred' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on abstract technical head nouns like "spaces", "theory", "concepts", "metrics" after a modifier (metric spaces, probability theory) in "application/use of X" phrases. Silent on "spaces" after "of" or "normed". Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Technical concept nouns after modifier

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments after a prefix like "ex" or "re" (ex|ch|anging, ex|op|lanets, re|do|x, Bol|tzmann), mid-word where the word continues. Mostly 'ch' in "exchanging", also "arranging", "retreating".
result.label: Mid-word fragment in exchanging/changing

result.description: Fires mostly on the hyphen in "problem-solving" (before "solving"), plus scattered function words and ' medieval'. It is silent on hyphens in other compounds like well-being, hands-on and next-generation. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Hyphen in problem-solving, mixed

result.description: Fires on the word " touch" / " Touch", especially as a modifier before words like screen, sensor, or points (touchscreen, touch technology). Members are mostly touch-token detectors. Predicts compound continuations such as screen, points, es, ing.
result.label: touch token (touchscreen compounds)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ont' inside "deontology" (and similar mid-word pieces like 'ont' in spontaneous), plus the '9' in 1944/1971 years. The word-initial 'ont' of "ontology" stays silent. Mixed trigger.
result.label: 'ont' in deontology; '9' in years

result.description: Fires mainly on the period ending a short name or title line in a list of names (e.g. "Tifinagh.", "Johannes Gutenberg."). Stays quiet on periods ending sentences in scientific prose. A few weaker hits on other word endings.
result.label: Period after list-item names

result.description: Fires mostly on ' memor' (as in "memorable") after verbs like create/provide in writing and storytelling text, and weakly on ' particip' and some function words. Likely predicts a word-completing continuation. Evidence is mixed beyond ' memor'.
result.label: ' memor' in memorable (storytelling)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " philosoph" / " Philosoph" (start of philosophy, philosophical, philosophies, philosophers), and predicts suffixes like "ical" and "ies". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: philosoph word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the capital ' S' token as a word-initial piece, mostly starting a rare name or term like Sino-Tibetan, Scytho-, Slavic, or Sculpture. Often follows 'the' in linguistic-group text. Predicts continuations like 'ocr', 'ansk'.
result.label: Capital ' S' word-initial piece

result.description: Fires on varied function words and verbs (of, involves, storing, and, from, :) in data-processing and analytics text, where a list of data-related objects is expected next (e.g. "vast amounts of", "involves storing"). Silent on "of" in generic structure-of phrases.
result.label: Data-processing text connectors before data objects

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Spe' at the start of a line or document, mainly the start of "Speech" as a heading. It predicts continuations like "ech" or "aking". It stays silent on other numbered-list items.
result.label: ' Spe' at start of Speech

result.description: Fires on function words (as, are, include, in, into) in abstract philosophy-of-mind prose, where the next word would be a philosophical term. Members are mostly philosophy/brain topic detectors; the same words in other topics stay silent.
result.label: Function words in philosophy text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Cont" at the start of a capitalized word, mostly before "inuous"/"inuity" in headings and titles. It stays silent on the full word "continuity" in running text. Weak activity on a few other tokens.
result.label: Cont- word-start piece (Continuous)

result.description: Fires on the article ' a' (rarely ' an') right after "maintain/maintaining" (also weakly after "ensure", "commitment to"), where an abstract noun like balance or approach comes next. Silent on ' a' after other words.
result.label: ' a' after "maintain"

result.description: Fires on clause-boundary punctuation (';', ',', '),', ' while') after a list or classification of technical terms, especially chemistry/polymer structure types. Silent on some ';' in general science text. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Clause punctuation in technical classification lists

result.description: Fires on ' O' in "Big O" (complexity notation) in computer science text. It stays silent on ' O' directly before a parenthesis, as in "O(n log...)". Members are O-token detectors plus algorithm and complexity context.
result.label: Big O notation ' O'

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces of technical or academic nouns (-ers, -ologies, -eters, -ity, closing parentheses) in lists of fields or technologies, where a relative clause or modifier like "that/which/designed" tends to follow. Inconsistent across contexts.
result.label: Technical noun endings before relative clause

result.description: Fires on function words and suffixes (' of', 'ing', ' in', ' that') right after "maintain(ing)" or similar in food-safety and kitchen hygiene text, where the next word is likely equipment or tools. Silent on many ' of' elsewhere.
result.label: Maintaining hygiene in kitchen text

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' person', 'on', commas, ' rate', ' to') in expository academic text, often within lists or linguistics/technical prose. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the logits are not coherent.
result.label: Scattered tokens in expository lists

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' the', ' a', ' and', ' but') and verbs like 'facilitate'/'supports' in abstract essay prose about communication, emotion and understanding. Silent on ' the' after plain verbs elsewhere. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function words in communication essays

result.description: Fires mostly on " heavily" after verbs like "relies/relied" (reliance adverb before "on"), with weaker hits on commas, quotes and other mid-list tokens. Silent on "heavily" after "GPS" before "utilize", so it needs the "relies heavily on" construction.
result.label: relies heavily on

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' ex' (esp. "cultural ex|changes") and ' syn' that begin a longer word, mostly after "cultural". Silent on some ' ex' in other contexts, so the condition is partly unclear.
result.label: ' ex' fragment in cultural exchanges

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ological' when it completes "technological" (techn+ological), predicting words like advancements, innovation, progress. Silent on 'ological' in bi-ological, Ge-ological or standalone.
result.label: techn-ological word completion

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'lic' in "implicature" and 'lev' in "Relevance", in linguistics/pragmatics text. Silent on 'lic' in "acrylics". Weak, mixed circuit; predicts word continuations like 'ature'.
result.label: 'lic'/'lev' in implicature, relevance

result.description: Fires most on the 'yg' piece in 'hygiene' (also 'polygons'), plus scattered mid-sentence function and verb tokens in formal expository text. Mixed and weakly consistent; the circuit is diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: 'yg' in hygiene, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on varied function words and connectors (' to', ' and', ',', ' a', ' lower') in economics/business text about production, costs and efficiency, where a change or effect is being described. Peak tokens are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Economics text connectors, scattered

result.description: Fires on ' used' (also 'employed') as a passive verb after "is/are/be" in explanatory text about a concept, method or term, typically before "to", "in" or "for". Silent when the sentence has no passive "used".
result.label: Passive 'is used' in explanations

result.description: Fires on " in" right after a noun of change or development (transformation, shift, changes, advancements) when the subject "underwent/experienced" a significant change. Silent on " in" after other nouns like "advancements in gene expression" or "in particular".
result.label: " in" after "underwent significant change"

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after a quantity or proportion word (percent, %, millions, hundreds, portion), where a total or amount comes next. Silent on ' of' after abstract nouns like extinction, beginning, welfare.
result.label: ' of' after percentages/quantities

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-sentence tokens (suffixes, 'of', 'this', hyphen, ' conditional', ' contain') in abstract explanatory prose about writing, math, or cooking. Peaks are inconsistent. Next-token logits are mixed and unclear.
result.label: Scattered tokens in explanatory prose

result.description: Fires on the verb ' learn' / ' learning' (also 'acquire') in text about language learning and education, as a standalone word. It stays silent when 'learn' is only the first piece of 'learners'.
result.label: learn / learning as standalone word

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment " correl" (as in "correlative conjunctions"), when a word is incomplete and likely continues with a suffix like -ative. Members detect correl-, rel-, figur-, cry- and similar stems.
result.label: " correl" word-start fragment

result.description: Diffuse target peaking on mixed function words and word pieces (' the', ' of', ' by', 'ric', 'ible') mid-phrase, often before a noun in abstract or technical prose. Silent on many ' the' cases; the evidence doesn't show what distinguishes them.
result.label: Mixed function-word mid-phrase positions

result.description: Fires weakly on varied function words and word pieces (' and', ' of', ' or', 'ates', 'ler') in abstract expository prose about communication, writing, or art. Peaks are inconsistent, and ' and' is often silent in lists, so no clear trigger.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository prose

result.description: Fires on function words and punctuation (commas, "where", "which", "(", "include") that open a clause or list elaborating on writing systems, language or scripts. Peak tokens are varied. Upstream members mostly carry language and script topic.
result.label: Clause openers in writing-system text

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ab' inside words and names (Al-Kitab, al-Jabr, syllabaries), plus some function words like 'of', 'and', 'as' after economics or labor nouns. Mixed and weakly faithful, so the function-word part is unclear.
result.label: 'ab' word piece, plus linking words

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (and, a, of, to, in, commas) in expository, abstract essay-style text, mostly where a noun or skill-type word is expected next. Silent on 'and' in lists of nouns. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Function words in expository prose

result.description: Fires on 'ough' in "Dough" at the very start of a document (a heading-like recipe step title such as "Dough Kneading"). It stays silent on 'ough' in "dough" mid-sentence. Weak activity on 'resolved'/'solved'.
result.label: Document-initial "Dough" heading

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and connectors (' se', ' the', ' and', commas, ' of', ' to') in technical expository text, mid-phrase before a noun object. Evidence is mixed; the logits lean weakly towards verbs like consult/govern/apply.
result.label: Function words in technical prose
enhance/increase verbs in narrative analysis
result.description: Fires on the end of verbs like "enhance/enhances/enhancing" (and "increase") when a literary or narrative analysis text says something improves the narrative or character development. It stays silent on noun "-ance" in words like relevance and resonance.

Fires mainly on ' grande' as a word-start piece in "grandeur" (after "the", "and", "of"), where the next piece completes the word. Members detect other incomplete word-start pieces (poly, sec, abs, commit).
result.label: ' grande' in grandeur

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sed' when it starts a split word like sediment/sedimentary, mostly in geology text. It predicts the word continuation (iment, iments).
result.label: ' sed' start of sediment

result.description: Fires on words within phrases about writing systems (e.g. "influential syllabaries", "logographic system", "among the many") in text on scripts like Chinese, Japanese, Hangul. Silent on "orthographic" and "cartographic", so it needs the script-type context.
result.label: Writing-system descriptors (logographic, syllabaries)

result.description: Fires on the verb "ensure" and its inflections (ens-ures, ensuring, ensure) when it introduces a result clause, e.g. "X ensures that…". It stays silent on "ures" in "failures", so it needs the ensure word.
result.label: verb "ensure" inflections

result.description: Fires on ' In' as a word-initial piece at the start of a longer word split into tokens (In-novation, In-complete, In-surance), predicting a continuation like 'sur', 'nov'. Silent on 'In' in Infrastructure.
result.label: ' In' as word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on causal or initiating verbs and links (initiat-ating/ates, cause, trigger, leading to, resulting in) in chemistry/biochemistry process text, where something leads to a following event. Silent on -ating in non-causal words like investigating.
result.label: Causal/initiating verbs in chemical processes

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' with', ' the', ' of', ' to', ' every') and a few word pieces like 'ological' in explanatory academic text. It is silent on ' with' after a comma in descriptive lists. Evidence is mixed, and the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ass" inside "all-encompassing" (adjective form, before "-ing"). It stays silent on "ass" in "encompasses" or "affect ass", so it needs that specific word.
result.label: "ass" in "all-encompassing"

result.description: Fires on commas (and "of", "standing") in philosophy-themed abstract prose, especially after sentence-opening phrases like "As such," or "In philosophy,". Silent on commas in other clauses, even in philosophical text. Predicts no clear next token.
result.label: Commas after philosophical sentence openers

result.description: Fires on verbs, prepositions and connectives (of, using, include, where, ;) in text about computer/network security and access control, where a security-related noun such as encryption or authentication is likely to come next. Silent on generic 'of' in other text.
result.label: Function words in security text

result.description: Fires on "the"/"The", mostly at the start of a sentence or clause in culinary-arts and historical-period text. It stays silent on many other "the" tokens, such as "during the early 2…". Members include culinary-topic features.
result.label: "the" in culinary history text
'of' after "array/multitude" in biodiversity
result.description: Fires on ' of' (and sometimes ' the'/' and') after quantity nouns like "array", "multitude", "range" in biodiversity definitions, before listing organisms. Similar ' of' contexts in nearby text stay silent, so the evidence for the condition is thin.

result.label: Materials behavior "under different conditions"
result.description: Fires on words like "different", "various", "to", "under" in materials-science text, mostly right after "under" or "subject to", where a conditions/loading noun is expected next. Silent on "different" in other constructions (e.g. "due to different").
Fires mainly on " ray" (light rays, ray diagrams) and also " LED", in optics/light-technology text. Silent on other optics text without those tokens. Weak extras on a few other tokens.
result.label: Optics ' ray' and ' LED'

result.description: Fires on varied function words and mid-phrase tokens (the, and, a, by, of, through) in expository text, where a noun or list continuation is expected. Silent on 'the' after a date or introductory comma. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function words mid-phrase in expository text

result.description: Fires on commas (and 'and') in a list of resources right after "time" (e.g. "including time, budget and..."), predicting further resource nouns like money, cost, capital. Silent on commas after "time" in other constructions.
result.label: Comma after 'time' in resource lists

result.description: Fires on a comma that ends a complete clause in technical computing/algorithm text, where a participial or relative continuation ("which", "thereby", "allowing") follows. It stays quiet on commas after "therefore", sentence-initial phrases, or in lists.
result.label: Clause-final comma in technical prose

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment (mostly 'inf' in rainfall, 'apt' in presynaptic/synaptic, also 'mit', 'pend') where the word is incomplete and a suffix follows. Seems to depend on being inside those specific words, in science text.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: rainfall, synaptic

result.description: Fires on the word " solutions" (also " solution") as a noun, typically after modifiers like "innovative", "end-to-end" or "storage". Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' solutions' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " real" when it begins "realm" (e.g. "in the realm of", "digital realm"), also "realization". It is silent on "real-time". Upstream members detect " real" and "realm of" style contexts, such as "the ___ of".
result.label: " real" in "realm"

result.description: Fires on the word " budget" in text about budget types and public finance. Members are mostly detectors of " budget" and budget-related word pieces. It pushes towards continuations like "ary", "allocation" and "constraints".
result.label: ' budget' token detector

result.description: Fires on " to" right after "cater/catering" (also weakly "refers to", "appeal to"), where a noun phrase about audiences or needs follows. Silent on other "to" uses like "due to", "compared to", or infinitive "to".
result.label: "to" after cater/catering

result.description: Fires on commas and connectives (to, can, by, or) in text about DNA mutation and genetic change, where the next word is likely a mechanism like "random" or "mutation". Silent on commas in other biology or general topics.
result.label: Connectives in mutation/genetics text

result.description: Fires on ' both', 'a/an' or 'significant' right after a verb like "presents/poses/offers", where the next word is likely "opportunities", "challenges" or "difficulties". Silent on 'both' after prepositions or "promote/development of".
result.label: Presents both/a → opportunities/challenges

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'l' in "pro-l-iferation"/"prolific" (also 'w' in "prowess"), a mid-word piece after "pro" or "over" where a suffix like -iferation or -ess is expected. Weak on other mid-word pieces. Silent on 'l' in "potlucks".
result.label: mid-word 'l' in proliferation
' full' before potential/range nouns
result.description: Fires on the word ' full' as a modifier, mostly in "the full potential/range/breadth of", and also in "full backups". It predicts extent nouns like spectrum, range, scope, extent and potential.

Fires on the hyphen right after "well" (and weakly "lesser") when it starts a compound modifier like well-oiled, well-known, well-ordered. It stays silent on hyphens after other words such as acetyl-, two-, bird-. It predicts "known", "defined", etc.
result.label: Hyphen after "well-" compounds

result.description: Fires on connectives (commas, "and", "the", "or") inside lists or clauses in international finance and currency/exchange-rate text, where the next word is likely an economic noun such as "flows" or "predictions". Silent on commas in general text.
result.label: Connectives in currency/finance lists

result.description: Fires on commas (sometimes 'and') inside lists of sound, perception or music-related properties (pitch, sounds, touch, hearing, visual), where another list item comes next. Silent on commas after clauses or before 'which'/'such as'.
result.label: List commas in sound/perception lists

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ass' inside words like reassurance, assume, potassium, but also on some other word pieces and function words after "development of". Silent on 'ass' in "encompasses". Mixed evidence.
result.label: 'ass' word piece (reassurance, assume)

result.description: Fires on infinitive ' to' (also 'can'/'could') after a technology or tool noun, introducing a purpose clause about what the tech is used for. It predicts verbs like create, simulate, monitor. It stays quiet on 'expected to' and 'back to'.
result.label: purpose 'to' after technology nouns

result.description: Fires mostly on ' a' (also ' of', ' to') after a verb like "create", "employs" or "utilizes" in tokamak/fusion text, where the next word is likely "Tok"/"tor"-type (toroidal, tokamak). Silent on ' a' in unrelated contexts.
result.label: 'a' before tokamak/toroidal term

result.description: Fires on the token ' Tai' (also rarely ' Gram'), mostly when it is followed by a hyphen or dash and another name-like piece, as in odd "Tai-Kada" strings. The evidence is thin and noisy; weak activations appear on word fragments.
result.label: ' Tai' before hyphenated name

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' dup', ' imp', ' multip', ' rep' that are followed by "lication"/"licity" (duplication, implication, multiplicity, replication). Predicts the continuation 'lications'/'lication'. Members are detectors of these prefixes.
result.label: Prefix before -lication (dup/imp/multip)

result.description: Fires on the word " operating" (and "ating" in "Operating System"), strongest in "operating system(s)" contexts, and weaker in "operating temperatures/parameters". It pushes the next token towards "systems/system".
result.label: "operating" before systems

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ert' inside "inertial"/"inertia" (in|ert|ial), mostly in physics text. Weaker on a few other mid-word pieces like ' ende' and ' puzz'. Predicts suffix pieces like 'ia' and 'ial'.
result.label: 'ert' in inertia/inertial

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' sed' and ' sent' that begin a longer word like sediment or sentiment/sentient/sentinel, predicting 'iments'/'iment'/'ience' next. Silent when the whole word is already given.
result.label: sed-/sent- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the token "IP" (intellectual property, or IPv4/IPv6 addresses), including with or without a leading space. Many members are IP detectors; others relate to rights and copyright. Predicts suffixes like "R", "right", "v".
result.label: IP token (intellectual property / IPv)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'ient' (as in experiential) and 'ific' (Artificial) where the word is unfinished and the next piece is likely 'ial'. It mostly sits inside multi-piece words.
result.label: Word piece before 'ial' ending

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' imag' (imaging, imagery, imaginary) and ' infl' (inflation) when a longer word is split, predicting suffix pieces like 'ery' or 'ation'. Mostly ' imag' detectors feed it.
result.label: imag-/infl- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word "economic" (mostly the final piece 'ic' after "Econom", also " economic"), as an adjective before nouns like crises, growth, theory. Silent on 'ic' ending other words (strategic, systemic, esoteric).
result.label: Economic (Econom-ic) adjective

result.description: Fires mostly on " of" right after "survival" (survival of the species), and sometimes on "back" in "traced back". Silent on " of" after other nouns like "secrets", "combination", "myriad". Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: "survival of" and "back" connectors

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' behav' (start of "behaviors"), mostly after adjectives or nouns like animal, social, adaptive. It predicts the suffix 'iors'/'iour'.
result.label: ' behav' piece before -iors

result.description: Fires on ' beta' (also 'eta' in Beta, 'amma' in gamma) in radioactive decay text, e.g. "beta decay" and "beta-minus". It predicts decay-related continuations such as ' decay', '+' and ' minus'.
result.label: beta in radioactive decay

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Inter" (capitalized, with a space) when it begins a longer word such as Interactive, Interfaces, Interpreted or Inter-process. It pushes the next token toward continuations like active, mediate, action, pret and faces.
result.label: Inter- word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mit' (mitochondria, mitigation, mitral, mitosis) and on ' Luther' after 'Martin'. Both are word-start fragments that precede a continuation; the target is silent on unrelated biology text.
result.label: ' mit' fragments and Martin Luther

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sust' at the start of "sustainable/sustainability/sustain", predicting the continuation 'ain'. Members are mostly ' sust' detectors plus environmental/waste context features. Silent on a few ' sust' cases, with no clear reason.
result.label: ' sust' word-start predicting 'ain'

result.description: Fires on the piece "out" in "Throughout" (also weakly on " throughout"), typically at the start of a sentence like "Throughout history". It predicts " history" and similar time-span words next.
result.label: "out" in "Throughout"

result.description: Fires on abstract plural or mass nouns ending a noun phrase (connections, constructs, spaces, processes, structures, patterns) in abstract social/academic prose, where a locative preposition like "within" or "among" may follow. Silent on some 'construct's in philosophical contexts.
result.label: Abstract plural noun before locative preposition

result.description: Fires on the noun " transformation", mostly in "underwent/experienced a (significant) transformation" sentences about a field or industry changing. Weaker on "Digital transformation" and similar change nouns like "changes" or "phase".
result.label: ' transformation' as change noun

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (of, in, their, -ive) in biology/taxonomy text about diversity, uniqueness and classification of organisms. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the same ' of' stays silent in other contexts.
result.label: Diversity/classification text, scattered function words

result.description: Fires on commas, "), " and "or" separating items in a list of climate zone types (tropical, dry, temperate, ...), after a zone name. Silent on commas in other climate sentences that aren't listing zone categories.
result.label: Commas in climate zone lists

result.description: Fires on prepositions (from, of, by) and "-able" endings in risk-management text, where the next word is likely an unexpected or disruptive event (events, unexpected, sudden). Silent on ' by' in ordinary agent or means constructions.
result.label: Prepositions before unexpected disruptions

result.description: Fires on commas (also 'or'/'and') inside lists of media or document types (videos, articles, reports, emails), where another item of the same kind is expected next. Silent on commas after abstract design or policy items.
result.label: Commas in media/document type lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'asc' inside 'cardiovascular' (also 'vascular'), predicting the 'ular' continuation. Weakly fires on other mid-word fragments such as 'erc' in coercion.
result.label: 'asc' in cardiovascular

result.description: Fires on a scattered mix of tokens (' Web', 'NO', odd byte pieces, ' spin', ' hierarchy', ' overflow'), mostly technical or math words. Members are generic fragment detectors with no discriminative signal, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered technical word fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' decision', mostly in "informed decision-making" and similar compounds, and pushes the next token towards "-" and "making". Members are mostly ' decision' detectors. Weak activation on "problem-solving".
result.label: ' decision' before -making

result.description: Fires on "have"/"having" (also "possess") as a main verb of possession or requirement, especially after "to", "should", "must", or "and" in advice-like text, predicting a noun phrase like "sufficient" or "a robust". Silent on "may have" and "some have".
result.label: have/having as possession verb

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens (' something', 'friend' in user-friendly, list commas, ' series'/' collection' after 'a') where a noun or compound continuation is expected. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered something/friend/list-comma slots

result.description: Fires mainly on ' transparent' (also 'clarify', 'ial' in confidential) in lists of organizational virtues like "transparent, inclusive, reliable" in governance and communication text. Weakly on related openness words.
result.label: Transparent in organizational virtue lists

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ens' inside the word "licensing" (lic|ens|ing), after the "lic" fragment. Members are mostly 'ens' detectors, including in other words like "comprehensiveness" and "censored".
result.label: 'ens' in "licensing"

result.description: Fires on clause-boundary tokens (semicolon, ' and', comma, period) after a negated or contrasting clause, where the next clause is expected to contrast or continue ("instead", "rather", "nor", "it"). Silent on some semicolons in other contexts.
result.label: Clause boundary after negated statement

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ut' in "poll|ut|ants" and "scr|ut|iny", plus a few similar mid-word pieces (conj, eg, circul). It stays silent on 'ut' in "pharmaceutical", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: 'ut' inside pollutants/scrutiny

result.description: Fires on the pivot word (" but", "'s", "also") in "not just/merely X but (also) Y" contrasts, where a noun or article like "a/an" is expected next. It is silent after "not only ... but also" in some contexts.
result.label: "not just X but Y" pivot

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' co' when it begins a longer word (cocktail, cooperative, cooperation, copper, coating) and pushes toward continuations like 'oper', 'ck', 'aching'. It stays silent on whole words such as 'collaboration'.
result.label: ' co' word-initial fragment

result.description: Fires on the final noun of a casual or humorous noun phrase (coffee break, cover song, kitchen experiment, joke, comedic relief), where a light-hearted event or moment noun completes the phrase. Evidence is mixed and the peak tokens are scattered.
result.label: Light-hearted event noun ending phrase

result.description: Fires on varied function words and punctuation (commas, '),', hyphen, 'of', 'the') in academic or technical expository text about science, math, or music, where a noun or technical term is expected next. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Punctuation/function words in technical prose

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-sentence tokens (function words, word pieces, 'as', 'the', 'a') in abstract explanatory text, often about geology or earth processes. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weak, so the pattern is thin.
result.label: Scattered tokens in explanatory science prose

result.description: Fires on the word " objective", mostly as an adjective meaning impartial or fact-based (objective analysis, criteria, reality). It also fires more weakly on the noun meaning "goal". It pushes toward words like reality, evaluation and criteria.
result.label: ' objective' adjective (impartial/criteria)

result.description: Fires on "or" / "even" / "and" in escalating quantity phrases like "dozens or even thousands", predicting a larger number word (millions, thousands). Silent on "even" before comparatives ("even more").
result.label: Escalating quantity "or even" connector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'comple' in "Incompleteness" (Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem), a mid-word fragment. It stays silent on 'complex' or 'computational' words. Members are math and logic context plus word-piece detectors.
result.label: 'comple' in Incompleteness

result.description: Fires on varied function words and verbs in descriptions of buildings or artifacts "not just/only X but also Y", or "designed to reflect/symbolize/embody", where the next word is likely a purpose, function or quality (functionality, utility, spiritual, art).
result.label: Structures reflecting function and symbolism

result.description: Fires on a period ending a sentence about applications or impact of a technique across fields, where the next sentence likely starts with a subject like a field or domain (sports, medicine). Silent on periods before paragraph breaks or in abbreviations.
result.label: Period after applications-across-fields sentence

result.description: Fires on the word piece " alleg" at the start of "allegory/allegories/allegorical", mostly in literary-analysis text. Members are mostly detectors of the same " alleg" piece, plus narrative-related context.
result.label: ' alleg' (allegory) word piece

result.description: Fires on the "ile" piece in "Agile"/"agile" (software methodology), pushing toward words like method, response, iteration. Weaker on "ile" in other words and on "crowdsourcing". Members are mostly "ile" detectors plus agile-topic context.
result.label: Agile 'ile' token

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized proper name or name stem (Han, Mong, Pear, Leonard, Num) that is likely to continue into a longer name or word, e.g. Han Dynasty, Mongolian, Pearson. Mostly Chinese/Mongol history contexts.
result.label: Name-start piece like Han, Mong

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and mid-phrase tokens (of, the, in, and, most, flat) in abstract academic expository text, where the next word is an open content slot. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Mid-phrase function words in academic prose

result.description: Fires on the article ' a'/' an' after "is"/"becomes" when a definitional noun phrase follows, in essays about language and rhetoric (understatement, oxymoron). It predicts nouns like device, technique or literary.
result.label: Article 'a' defining rhetorical device

result.description: Fires on the word " products" (also "product"/"goods" upstream) as the object of verbs like create, provide, deliver, in business or product-development text, often before "or services". Members are mostly product/goods token detectors.
result.label: ' products' as business object noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece " contrib" when it is the start of a participle like "contributing", usually after an adverb such as "ultimately" or "significantly". It predicts "uting", "uted" or "utions" next.
result.label: ' contrib' before -uting
'yn' piece before 'thesis' words
result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'yn' inside technical words like nucleosynthesis, photosynthesis, polynomial and Keynesian, predicting 'thesis'-like continuations. Weaker, scattered firing on other tokens (' two', ' on', ' more').

Fires mainly on " together" (also combine/combined) after verbs of joining, merging, or collaborating, where the things are being brought into one whole. Predicts create/forming-type continuations. Silent on text about word arrangement without joining.
result.label: Joining things together

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "out" in "out-of-order" (also "out-" and "off-" compounds), plus scattered word-internal pieces like "ash" in Krashen and "for". Silent on hyphens after long, energy, water or Bio. Mixed evidence.
result.label: hyphen after "out" (out-of-order)

result.description: Fires on the "id" piece inside "Solidarity" (Sol|id|arity), after the "Sol" token. It is silent on "id" in "rigid" or at text start. Members detect solid/Sol/sol word pieces. Logits favour suffixes like "itude" and "arin".
result.label: "id" in Sol-id-arity

result.description: Fires on the word " food" / " Food" as a standalone noun or heading, e.g. "Food and Religion" or "makes food delicious". Quiet in "types of food items", where it modifies a following noun.
result.label: Word "food" as noun or heading

result.description: Fires on prepositions and connectors (mostly "on", also "in", "of", "and") after teaching/training/instruction words in education descriptions, where a field of study or subject is about to be named. Silent on "on" in other uses like "focused on interpretation".
result.label: Preposition before subject taught

result.description: Fires on the word piece " mo" when it begins "moisture" (after soil, atmospheric, release, adequate), predicting a continuation like "isture". Members are mostly " mo" detectors.
result.label: " mo" start of "moisture"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer technical words, mostly ' prec' (before 'ursor'), also 'VP', 'ium', ' diagn'. Logits promote continuations like 'ursor'/'urs'. Appears in science and chemistry text, mid-word.
result.label: ' prec' word-piece before 'ursor'

result.description: Fires on function words (the, to, an) in explanations of periodic trends, especially atomic radius decreasing or increasing across a period or group, where the next word is likely a change word like decrease or increase. Silent on 'the' in other chemistry text.
result.label: Periodic trend: atomic radius change

result.description: Fires on domain adjectives (social, political, scientific, cultural) in lists of broad societal factors or drivers of historical change, e.g. "the social and economic changes". Predicts nouns like changes and factors.
result.label: Societal-domain adjectives before changes

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ative" in "indicative", as in "is indicative of". It stays silent on "ative" in other words such as "communicative". Weaker activation on "indications" and "due" (to).
result.label: "indicative" suffix before "of"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cru' at the start of "crucial", "crucible" and "crude", predicting a continuation like 'cial' or 'cible'. Members are mostly ' cru' detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: ' cru' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " att" as the start of a longer word (attitudes, attraction, attribution), predicting continuations like "raction", "itudes", "ribution". Silent on unrelated tokens.
result.label: ' att' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'ra' in "engraving" and 'eb' in "lifeblood" (also eyebrow), where a word is partly spelled and a continuation is expected. Weak firing on a few other tokens.
result.label: 'ra' in engraving, 'eb' in lifeblood

result.description: Fires on ' can' directly after a noun-phrase subject (often abstract or plural, e.g. "misuse of colons can"), where a verb like be/cause/help follows. It stays quiet on pronoun or relative-clause subjects such as "they can" or "readers can".
result.label: ' can' after noun-phrase subject

result.description: Fires on " needs" as the noun after a stakeholder word like consumer, customer, user or market (e.g. "meet consumer needs"). Also fires weakly on "demands" and "expectations" in business and marketing text.
result.label: Customer/consumer "needs" noun

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' its', ' with', 'ifications', commas) in technical or descriptive prose, where a descriptive noun or modifier phrase is expected next. The peaks are inconsistent, and ' its' is silent in some contexts.
result.label: Scattered function words before descriptive noun

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens mid-word, mostly 'ph' after 'al'/'ale'/'as' (alphabet, aleph, asphalt), also 'ak' in Nanak and ' pre' before 'historic'. It is silent on 'ph' at word start or in 'deciphering'.
result.label: Mid-word 'ph' fragment in al- words

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-phrase tokens (' and', ' personal', ' shared', ' like', ' on') inside text about human communication and relationships. Peaks are inconsistent; members mostly carry communication/listening topic context.
result.label: Communication-topic scattered function words

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, prepositions, word pieces like 'etic', 'ac', 'ways') in chemistry/biology text, especially around "synthetic" and molecules. It is inconsistent: 'etic' itself is silent after "synth" in the contrast. Evidence is mixed; the circuit failed.
result.label: Chemistry/biology text, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment (h in Al-Khwarizmi, bo in carbohydrate, Ne in von Neumann) in a rare multi-piece word, where the next piece is a predictable continuation. Silent on misspelled or garbled variants like "bohydrates".
result.label: Mid-word piece in split rare words

result.description: Fires on function words and commas right after a historical period phrase (e.g. "15th and 16th centuries,", "period marked by", "saw the") in Renaissance or medieval history text, where a description of the era follows. Silent after similar period phrases in other contexts.
result.label: Era phrase connector in Renaissance history

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' stream' when it is likely to continue as 'streamlines' / 'streamlined' (e.g. fluid dynamics streamlines), predicting 'line', 'lined', 'lines' next. Upstream members are mostly ' stream' detectors.
result.label: ' stream' before -line/-lined

result.description: Fires on prepositions and linking words (of, in, on, supporting) right after "role/determinant/impact" phrases in soil moisture and plant-growth text, predicting plant, soil or agriculture terms next. Silent on similar "role of" phrases in general ecology or climate text.
result.label: Soil moisture linking prepositions

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ins" when it starts "insights", after verbs like offer/provide or adjectives like important/practical. It stays quiet on " ins" in other words such as insurance or insulators, and in one "giving deep ins" case.
result.label: " ins" of "insights"

result.description: Fires mid-word on pieces like 'ole'/'cular' in "intermolecular", plus apostrophes before t/s in contractions (isn', won'), and some other word fragments. Pushes toward ' forces'. Mixed, low-consistency peaks.
result.label: Intermolecular fragments and apostrophes

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'vent' inside "inter-vent-ions" (also con-vent-ional, sol-vent, ele-vent-h), predicting suffixes like 'ions'/'ional'. A few weaker peaks on other mid-word pieces (all-ure, teleport-ation).
result.label: 'vent' mid-word piece (interventions)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces, mostly ' in' and ' of' after a noun, plus 'iders' and 'ut'. Members are many ' in' detectors, including the 'in-' prefix. It is silent on some ' in' after nouns like belief or trust. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed ' in' / ' of' connector tokens

result.description: Fires on the final piece of a split food-ingredient word (choc-olate, pot-ato, tom-ato, pump-kin) in culinary or recipe text, where a noun like sauce, breast or roll tends to follow.
result.label: Food ingredient word endings
Connectives in technical business/data text
result.description: Fires on connectives like ' and', ',', ' of' and ' data' in expository text about software, business intelligence, data and technology, where a list or noun phrase is continuing. Silent on many ' and' tokens in other contexts.

Fires on the end of an adjective or field word (pharmaceut-ical, biotechn-ological, industrial, medical, engineering) that is likely followed by a noun like "industry", "sector" or "landscape". Silent on "ical" in analytical or statistical.
result.label: Sector adjective before 'industry'

result.description: Fires on function words and connectors (of, that, with, shapes) in philosophical text about death and existence, where the next word is likely 'death' or 'existence'. Silent on 'understanding of' in other philosophy contexts.
result.label: Function words in existential death philosophy

result.description: Fires on the hyphen in "decision-" (and data-, leader-) where "making/maker" is expected next, and on "standpoint"/"perspective" in "from an X standpoint/perspective". Silent on hyphens in other compounds like long-term or thrill-seekers.
result.label: decision-making hyphen / standpoint

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece "um"/"UM" completing "datum" (dat+um) in geodesy text, with a few weaker hits on other tokens. Members detect "dat", reference frame, coordinate and geodesy terms.
result.label: "um" ending "datum" in geodesy

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " influ" (as in influential, influences), including "influ" mid-word before "ential"/"ences". It predicts completions like "ential" and "ence". Members are mostly "influ" detectors.
result.label: " influ" word-start piece
Word-initial "pro" piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " pro" / " Pro", as in proactive, proton, probability, probe, proletariat. It predicts continuations like "active", "gression" and "tot". The contrast has no "pro" token, so it stays silent there.

Fires on the word-start pieces " intr" (intricate, intrigue) and " del" / " Del" (delving, delicate), predicting continuations like 'icate', 'igue', 've'. Appears in descriptive, literary-style prose; silent on the contrast text, which lacks these pieces.
result.label: intr- / del- word starts (intricate, delve)

result.description: Fires on the word pieces completing "Swiss Army knife" (' kn', 'ife', 'ives'), also ' Sur' in "Surface". Silent on 'ife' in ordinary "knife" phrases without Swiss Army, so it needs the Swiss Army Knife idiom.
result.label: Swiss Army knife completion

result.description: Fires mostly on " its" (also "the", "a", "be") after "since"/"from"/"to", where a word like "early", "initial" or "inception" is expected next. Silent on " its" in other constructions, such as "contributed to its ongoing". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: "its" before early/initial-type words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' convers' (start of conversation/conversational) and predicts a suffix like 'ational' or 'ations'. It was silent on one text-initial 'conversational AI' example, so it may need preceding context.
result.label: ' convers' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ifer' inside 'proliferation' (also non-proliferation, proliferate), predicting suffixes like -ation/-ate/-ant. Members are mostly 'ifer' detectors plus other mid-word pieces that precede a suffix.
result.label: 'ifer' in proliferation

result.description: Fires on the piece 'et' inside "multifaceted" (multifac|et|ed), predicting the suffix 'ed'. Members detect 'et' and 'fac' pieces; it is weaker in the hyphenated "multi-faceted" form.
result.label: 'et' in multifaceted

result.description: Diffuse target peaking on mixed tokens (word pieces, commas in repeated-backslash text, function words, non-English fragments) in technical or academic prose. Weak consistency; logits mildly favor 'simulation'-type words. Evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Diffuse technical-prose mid-word pieces

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' certain', ',', ' the', 'into', 'of') in abstract expository text about communication or concepts, where the next word is a mid-phrase noun or word piece. Peaks are inconsistent; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed function words in expository prose

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ed' of "trac-ed" in "can be traced back to" (origin tracing), with a weaker secondary peak on ' b' in "(ionic) b-onds". Silent on other '-ed' endings like "rooted" or "sprouted".
result.label: 'traced' back-to-origin 'ed'

result.description: Fires on function words (the, their, to, -ly) inside a playful chemistry text describing atoms/ions as party guests and hosts. Silent on 'the' in other topics. Predicts party/guest/electron words.
result.label: Atoms-as-party-guests function words

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start 'conscious' (' conscious' before -ness, 'apt' in 'synaptic') in neuroscience and philosophy-of-mind text. It predicts suffix continuations like 'ness'. Silent on at least one 'conscious' after 'human'.
result.label: conscious / synaptic word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the '0' right after the initial '2' in 21st-century year/decade strings like "2020s" or "2030s", where the next digit is 2 or 3. It stays silent on '0' in 1950s, 1980s or 300 BC.
result.label: '0' in 2020s-style years
